newsitem.title: USA: RAC Financial Chairman Mankoff retires.
newsitem.headline: RAC Financial Chairman Mankoff retires.

text.p: RAC Financial Group Inc said on Friday that Ronald Mankoff has announced his retirement as chairman of the company's board, effective October 1.
The company issued a statement saying he will remain a director of the company.
Mankoff was an RACF founding shareholder who engendered and negotiated many of its initial financial relationships, the company said.
Daniel Phillips, RACF president and chief executive officer, has assumed the responsibilities of chairman.
